_comment: DEF-RET expected_return_type A/B (experiment 005, postmortem-009). Each model appears twice: an -A agent (context_expected_return_type:true — the seeded holes' expected_return_type brief is injected into the initial problem.md) and a -B agent (false — withheld). The -A/-B delta in first-round fill correctness (status:passed: check --strict clean + holes --deps reports no remaining holes + verify accepts both bodies, on the first attempt) is the DEF-RET verdict. n = run_count per cell × 3 model families = 9 attempts per condition (18 total). The metric is whole-run pass/fail per the existing evaluator stop policy; quality_grade is secondary. Requires the prepare_run.py --context-expected-return-type hook (threaded from context_expected_return_type by run_matrix.py) and the seeded-return-holes scaffold template.
_feasibility_gate: DO NOT LAUNCH until the `llmll` on PATH is a DEF-RET build. As of authoring, `llmll version` reports 0.12.1 — predates DEF-RET (DEF-RET is v0.13.1/v0.13.2 on `main`, package.yaml 0.13.2). A 0.12.1 binary rejects schemaVersion 0.7.0 and does not parse `return_type` on def/def-shell, so check/holes/verify will fail on BOTH arms (no differential, false-null). Before launch: rebuild/install llmll from `main` HEAD and confirm `llmll version` reports >= 0.13.2 AND a checkout/holes probe on .llmll/templates/seeded-return-holes/scaffold.ast.json (with return_type re-declared) surfaces expected_return_type. Then dry-run with `--prepare-only` and diff arm-A vs arm-B problem.md (only the Hole brief block differs).
_cmd_note: cmd wrappers mirror manifest.b0-e004.json (the verified forms from prior runs). Confirm model IDs against your auth tier before launch: (1) codex 'gpt-5.5' uses bare `codex exec` with NO --model flag (API-key-only models are auth-rejected on ChatGPT-tier accounts, postmortem-001 F-102). (2) gemini-3-pro-preview may throttle; step down to gemini-2.5-pro if so. (3) claude model id set to claude-opus-4-8.
